name: SV-3
description: SV-3, or Ess-Vee-Three, was an L-1g general purpose droid that worked with the Barbadelan Karamu. When Karamu's Cranan star-hopper crashed onto Rendel, Ess-Vee was damaged. He was found by Han Solo and Chewbacca, and grabbed Solo, warning him of the "Emerald Witch" before deactivating.
